title: Robotic GMAW welding digital twin: process data, seam images, 3D scans and TRL 1-7 validation
description:
Multimodal dataset and validation tooling from a robotic GMAW (MAG) welding digital twin developed at ELTE Faculty of Informatics, Savaria Institute of Technology (Szombathely, Hungary).

Contents: 150 cell process logs (robot pose, torch signal, voltage, current, wire-feed speed; 5 travel speeds x 30-step synergic ramp, July 2023), 462 seam panoramas with metadata, 18 3D surface scans, CAD reference point clouds, derived seam segments, and the TRL 1-7 documentation with the TRL 5 validation of the process-data layer (blind annotation of seam boundaries, record-and-replay latency measurement, operator trial).

Class D (synthetic) files are labelled and are not real measurements; see EVIDENCE_POLICY.md.
